//! RED fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the EB-09 Bus-stream leg (P-045). The lint MUST reject
//! this module. A bus consumer subscribes WITHOUT a (tenant, subsystem) scope (and over a wildcard
//! `>` subject): a stream is provisioned PER (tenant, subsystem) — subject
//! `evt.<tenant>.<subsystem>...` (refined-arch event-bus §7.1); whitelist subjects, never `*` (§4.2
//! gotcha 1); `scope` is a bounded selector, never `*` (§4.3). An unscoped/wildcard subscription
//! crosses the tenant boundary (the cross-tenant frame-leak + firehose head-of-line stall).
//! @bus-stream

pub async fn start_consumer(bus: &Bus) -> SubStream {
    // BUG: subscribes to ALL streams with a wildcard subject and NO (tenant, subsystem) scope.
    bus.subscribe("evt.>", Scope::All)
        .await
        .expect("subscribe")
}
